Further, a comparative study between a conventional interior permanent magnet machine (IPM) (which has a high constant power speed range (CPSR)) and a VFPM is done.

articleTitle: Vehicle-grid system stability analysis considering impedance specification based on norm criterion
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In recent years, there exists some low frequency oscillation (LFO) events in high speed railway when multiple electric motor units are accessed to the traction network. To better deal with the problem, this paper regards the vehicle-grid system as a cascade system. The mathematical small-signal model of vehicle-grid system is established first. Then the norm stability criterion is adopted to analyze the system's stability considering the impedance specification of vehicles and grid. The simulation results show that the LFO can be analyzed with the method presented in this paper. In addition, an effective improvement measure is recommended to restrain the LFO of vehicle-grid system.

articleTitle: HILS-based analysis of characteristics and performance of internal combustion engine vehicles with varying battery types
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Along with the recent developments of environmentally friendly vehicles, there is an active technological development effort into the fuel efficiency enhancement of the existing internal combustion engine vehicles. As part of such technological development effort, researches are being conducted on the use of lithium batteries as the starter battery for internal combustion engine vehicles in place of lead-acid batteries, which have already been released as a test product for high-end vehicles. While the use of lithium starter battery as a replacement is expected to lead to various advantages and disadvantages at the same time, there is a lack of specific research on this area. Therefore, in this paper, we present a quantitative analysis of characteristics and performance in internal combustion engine vehicles with different battery types. For this purpose, we simulate a power-net system of a vehicle including charging control through a test bench based on actual vehicle data, and develop automotive power-net HILS by combining the test bench with a powertrain model. Based on HILS, we conduct tests of vehicles with AGM battery and lithium battery under various test scenarios, in order to comparatively analyze the characteristics and performance of the vehicle.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of nonlinear interior permanent magnet synchronous motors considering saturation and cross-magnetization effects
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper provides an analytical nonlinear model based on flux density of rotor and Winding function of the PMSM, which take into account the magnetic saturation. This model gives a clear physical picture for the saturation phenomenon in the d- and q-axis representation. Moreover, the saturation effect on the machine d- and q-axis synchronous reactance is investigated and the contributions of both the saturation factors and the cross-magnetizing phenomenon are also clearly shown. Using Ansoft to do offline parameter calculus of Flux and inductance, a simulation platform is established in Simulink using the equation of the nonlinear model demonstrated in the paper. The paper also presents the details of the experimental setup. And the proposed model is verified by the comparison of calculated and experimental results.

articleTitle: Enhanced electrochemical performance of surface-treated Li[Ni0.8Co0.1Mn0.1]O2 cathode material for lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In order to enhance the electrochemical performance of the Li[Ni0.8Co0.1Mn0.1]O2 cathode material synthesized using co-precipitation, its surface was coated with Al2O3 by using atomic layer deposition. The crystal structure of the bare and coated material was analyzed by X-ray diffraction (XRD) and field emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM). The material showed a layered structure and no impurity phase. No change in the crystal structure was observed after surface coating. The synthesized particles were spherical, with an approximate size of 5–20 µm. The prepared Li[Ni0.8Co0.1Mn0.1]O2 showed a fairly high discharge capacity of 241.8 mAh/g. After being coated with 3 nm of Al2O3, the electrochemical properties were enhanced, together with the charge/discharge cycling properties at room and elevated temperatures.

articleTitle: Improved switching selection for direct torque control of a five-phase induction motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved direct torque control (DTC) method for five-phase induction motor drive. The proposed DTC technique is accomplished by selecting the optimal voltage vector. Five-phase inverter has many case of voltage vector which compared to three-phase inverter. The voltage vectors are composed with two zero voltage vectors and thirty effective voltage vectors in five-phase inverter system. The voltage vectors are classified into the large voltage vector, medium voltage vector, and small voltage vector according to the magnitude of the voltage vector. Especially, the magnitude of the voltage vector is related to the torque ripple and the torque response of the machine. Therefore, the main idea of the proposed algorithm for DTC in the five-phase induction motor is the voltage vector selection for improving the torque ripple and torque response speed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Research on influences to reduce the commutation failure of different topology structures of STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In the unbalanced condition, theoretical derivation of STATCOM circulating current with MMC topology is presented. The current of cascade STATCOM using separate phase control is calculated. The research analyzes influence factors of commutation failure in multi-in feed HVDC system, and studies the influence of STATCOM to the running function of the HVDC system. Different topology structures of STATCOM have different influences to reduce the commutation failure, which provides the technical support of the design of the main circuit of STATCOM equipment. Finally, the paper chooses a main circuit topology of STATCOM providing a rapid response to the danger of commutation failure.

articleTitle: Design of bipolar pulse power supply based on LLC resonant converter for reactive sputtering process
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The next-generation display industry, it is necessary for the sputtering process to form a reactive thin film. However, the conventional power supply causes various problems such as high deposition rates and low arc energy, low efficiency in the reactive process. In this paper, we analyze the characteristics of a reactive process and proposed the existing techniques better process. Reactivity step of forming a stable plasma and improves the quality of the thin film. In addition, fast film formation speed, arc suppression, proposed a bipolar pulsed power supply unit in order to improve the deposition rate. The proposed power supply has a stable sputtering process performed by implementing a soft switching using the LLC resonant. LLC converters for high capacity 4 serial-parallel were constructed. The validity of this paper was verified through simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: The development of technology on reduces the SOC error rate using Hybrid Kalman Filter(HKF) and the demonstration its performance using BMS platform
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Generally, the BMS (Battery Management System) is core component of ESS and EV. And the news of BMS is very hot in relevant field. For BMS system, the SOC (State of Charge) algorithm is one of the most important core algorithms. In this paper, a battery SOC estimation method based on the hybrid Kalman filter is proposed. We combined ampere-hour counting method and Kalman filter-battery equivalent circuit method as the hybrid Kalman filter to estimate SOC value of batteries, and the error rate was smaller than using ampere-hour counting method and Kalman filter- battery equivalent circuit method separately. We did the demonstration experiments on the BMS platform which we have developed. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method

articleTitle: Control strategy of AC&DC hybrid generating system based on dual stator-winding induction generator for micro-grid application
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: For hybrid AC&DC micro-grid, this paper proposes a new generating system based on dual stator-winding induction generator (DWIG). This generating system can realize bidirectional energy flow, reduce the number of converters and simplify the structure of micro-grid. To meet the requirement of supplying AC and DC power simultaneously, this paper proposes the control winding voltage oriented (CWVO) control strategy on the basis of instantaneous reactive power theory. Through the analysis of simulation results, the feasibility and accuracy of this generating system and its control strategy is validated. This paper lays the foundation for future research for hybrid AC&DC micro-grid.

articleTitle: A three-phase DC-DC converter for low and wide input-voltage range application
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Output voltage of the fuel cell or Solar cell is often low and varies widely with the load and environmental condition. However, voltage stress of rectifier diodes is high and filter is large in the conventional voltage-source converter. Therefore, a three-phase DC-DC converter for low and wide input-voltage range application is proposed. It can operate at three modes, i.e., three-full-bridge, two-full-bridge, and one-full-bridge modes. Voltage stress of rectifier diodes and filter are reduced. Operating principle of the proposed converter is illustrated. Design guidelines and example are given. Simulation results of a three-phase DC-DC converter verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Three-level back-to-back converters with ESS directly connected to the lower DC-link
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: With the conventional circuit configuration of DC microgrids, two power conversion stages are required to transfer the energy from the Energy Storage System to loads or sources: DC/DC and DC/AC conversions. This paper proposes a new circuit configuration which puts the battery directly to the lower DC-link of 3-level back-to-back converters. The proposed circuit reduces the two-step power conversion stage to one-step. The working principle of the proposed circuit is analyzed, and the controllers for the circuit are designed. The validity of the control algorithm is verified by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal design of in-wheel motor for an E-bike
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to provide an optimal design of in-wheel motor as an electric bike (E-bike). The in-wheel motor has a direct-driven outer rotor type attached to the E-bike's rear wheel without any gear. The objective of the optimal design of this in-wheel motor is to improve the output characteristics of the motor and to have a stator form to facilitate automatic winding. Response surface methodology was used for the optimal design and 2-dimensional finite element method was used for electro-magnetic field analysis.

articleTitle: Design of an autonomous antarctic exploration platforms through manipulations of All-Terrain Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In Antarctica, there exists many crevasses which can be greatest risks to Antarctica exploration crew. In order to protect the scientists from these hazards, a robotic platform is being developed which can detect dangerous crevasses hidden below the surface. This paper presents such an effort to develop an unmanned vehicle by modifying a commercially available All Terrain Vehicle (ATV). The developed platform be driven autonomously given the user provided GPS trajectories in a harsh Antarctic environments. In order to provide such capabilities, several manipulators are designed on the throttle, break, steering wheel and gears of the ATV, each controlled by embedded motor drivers. The command to motor drivers are generated from the embedded controllers which can communicate wirelessly to either user command station or handheld remote controllers. This redundancy in the user input can enhance safety in an emergency situation. The developed platform is tested in many different experimental scenarios similar to the Antarctic exploration.

articleTitle: Estimating increase of electric energy according to penetration of electric vehicles at the Jeju Island in Korea
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The Jeju Special Self-Government Provincial Government has made the plan penetrating gradually EVs in the Jeju Special Self-Government Province. However the reports on effects of EV's penetration on the electrical grid of the Jeju are only a few. In this paper the yearly electric energy consumed by the EVs was calculated in the Jeju for the future 10 years and we hope that our study results will help the governors realize the EVs penetration plan in the Jeju.

articleTitle: Reducing computational time strategy for estimating core loss with spatial and temporal periodicity
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: For increasing system efficiency, proper loss estimation must be preceded. However performing core loss analysis on overall operation region is time consuming process. In this paper, reducing computation time strategy for estimating core loss with spatial and temporal periodicity is proposed. To validate whether this strategy is useful for complex motor configuration, it is applied to interior permanent magnet synchronous motors with various number of slot. Periodicity according to the different number of slot per pole per phase is considered as well. Lastly, core loss calculation results with full-period analyzed model, and strategy applied model are analyzed comparatively to verify its validity.

articleTitle: New direct torque control of asynchronous motor with low ripple in torque and current, and quick response
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In traditional direct torque control, there is usually undesired torque and current ripple, variable switching frequency and acoustic noises. A new direct torque control method is proposed in this paper. By analyzing the effect of voltage vector on the stator flux and electromagnetic torque under consideration of the voltage drop on the stator resistance, one can point out that the necessary condition for the increase of torque and the critical condition of the flux change are neglected, on the basis of above analysis, then a new voltage vector selection table is proposed. The amplitude of the commanding voltage vector depends on the duty ratio which is derived from the errors of torque and flux only. The duty ratio is simplified by using a two-step design minimum torque ripple in this paper. Simulation and experimental results are illustrated confirming the correctness and validity of theoretical analysis and that the torque and current ripple are reduced while response time of the control system is increased in this paper.

articleTitle: A study on the improvement of transient response during torque control of IPMSM
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: IPMSM has advantage of high efficiency than other types of motors because of its high generating output per unit volume. However, when torque controlled in certain transient state, the transient response difference occurs due to difference of magnetic resistance. It means that difference of response on q-axis and d-axis currents, thus causing the motor control performance is reduced in transient. Therefore, control measure, considering the rated parameter and driving speed of IPMSM and compensation technique for efficient motor drive are needed. In this paper, we will analyze the problem of the IPMSM drive systems. We will also propose algorithm that improves the transient response and will confirm it by simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Novel Spoke-Type BLDC Motor design for cost effective and high power density
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Recently because of the rise in the price of rare earth magnet, interest of non-rare earth or less-rare earth motor is growing. Especially to achieve the high power density, Spoke-Type BLDC (Brushless Permanent Magnet) Motor with ferrite permanent magnet are spotlighted. But Spoke-Type Ferrite BLDC Motor has much of magnetic flux leakage in the direction of rotor shaft. In order to solve this problem, there are two conventional ways. But conventional ways bring the increases of product cost or the decreases of the power density. Therefore this paper proposes new Spoke-Type BLDC Rotor shape that has the advantages of both conventional methods. The new shape is consists of a one-piece core. The inside and the outside of the rotor are open alternately. So it is possible to obtain a high output density with a small production cost.

articleTitle: Bi-directional DC-DC converter For ESS using the Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, we try to provide a bi-directional switching converter for ESS (Energy Storage System) using the droop control. Using the Droop control, and the operation at the set power capacity, in order to cope with when the voltage of the ESS is varied by charging and discharging, to work with buck and boost mode. An advantage when using the Droop Control, depending on the amount of required power, it is possible to adjust the output of the converter, also the rate of change in voltage during cooperation inverter or DC grid can be suppressed to a constant level is there. This, when working with inverters or DC grid, can provide the power loss caused by the voltage fluctuation. These things, to prove through the simulation.

articleTitle: A high power density and power factor cascade buck-boost PFC under expanded high line voltage
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, a control method to achieve a high power density and improve the power factor (PF) in the light load conditions for a voltage range of 180~305Vac using a cascade buck-boost PFC converter is proposed. Recently, the requirement of a 277Vac for an input voltage rather than a 240Vac has been increased in a power distribution stage. The output voltage of the PFC stage of the conventional boost PFC converter, which is widely used for the PFC stage, is increased to 450V under a voltage range of 180~305Vac compared to the output voltage (400V) under a voltage range of 180~264Vac, i.e, nominal 240Vac. Therefore, the volume of the output capacitor is also increased compared to a existing voltage range of 180~264Vac, which reduces the power density of the PFC stage. Moreover, the conventional boost PFC converter has a poor PF in the light load conditions due to the phase leading input current caused by the input capacitor. To overcome these problems, this paper proposes the control scheme using a cascade buck-boost PFC converter in order to achieve the conventional output voltage (400V) under a voltage range of 180~305Vac. Therefore, a smaller output capacitor can be used in the proposed method and achieve a high power density. Also, with proper control of an additional switch (Q1), the phase leading input current can be relieved. The concept and principles are explained and the performance of the proposed method is verified by the prototype converter with 800W conventional output (450V, 1.78A) and proposed output ( 400V, 2.00A).

articleTitle: An Innovative finite-time passivity-based control strategy for power management of PV/hybrid storage power system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The operation of stand-alone PV systems require the use of energy storage devices with advanced power management capacities to restrain the fluctuation of dc-bus voltage caused by the stochastic nature of solar irradiance and load resistance. The Maximum Power Point Tracking(MPPT) strategy is used for PV generator to better harness the solar energy. An innovative finite-time of passivity-based control (FT-PBC) is synthesized using the interconnection and damping assignment in order to manage power flow between batteries and ultracapacitors. In the FT-PBC, a new Lyapunov function with fractional power is designed to improve the transient performance of dc-bus voltage based on finite-time stabilization theory. Simulation of PV/hybrid storage system and evaluation of the proposed strategy are accomplished using MATLAB/simulink. The results demonstrate that the robustness of the proposed strategy for load resistance and solar irradiance changes.

articleTitle: DC micro grid energy management strategy based on a hierarchical dynamic adaptive droop control
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents an energy management strategy for DC micro grid based on a hierarchical dynamic adaptive droop control. This controller has two layers, dynamic droop parameter unit and mode transition unit. The dynamic droop parameter unit uses a PI controller to generate a dynamic voltage compensation, which can minimize circulating current between converters. The mode transition unit designate micro grid operation mode by DC bus voltage signal automatically. Finally, simulation studies are carried out by using Matlab/Simulink software to validate the proposed control strategy is effective.

articleTitle: Stabilizing electric vehicle lateral motion with considerations of state delay of active front steering system through robust control
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents a delayed robust control method for stabilizing vehicle lateral motion of electric vehicle equipped with active front steering system. The main objective is to improve electric vehicle lateral handling performance by dealing with the time delay problem. To address the challenge, the time delay embedded in steering system is concentrated in vehicle state. By defining Lyapunov-Krakovskii functional, sufficient conditions of the state-delayed robust controller are obtained and solved in terms of linear matrix inequalities. Simulations with a high-fidelity CarSim full-vehicle model demonstrate that the proposed method can stabilize electric vehicle lateral motion and enhance lateral handling performance.

articleTitle: Efficiency analysis of an electrification concept for a catering truck
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Electrification has a great potential to reduce both energy consumption and CO2 and pollutant emissions not only in passenger cars but also in heavy-duty and off-road vehicles. Hence, in this work the potential of full electrification of a catering truck is investigated. Here, besides the electrification of the traveling mechanism, the former hydraulic lift system with several functions and a corresponding load capacity of up to 5 tons is replaced by electric drives. So that the functions of the lift system are actuated by individual electric drives independently from the powertrain. The resulting electric system is compared to the current conventional system in terms of energy efficiency and environmental impact for the system's typical tasks with respect to specific user application profiles. The comparison states a large potential for efficiency increase through electrification over the entire life cycle of the catering truck. The opportunities for recovering both kinetic and potential energy are also discussed.

articleTitle: Reduction of DC-link current ripple in unbalanced three-parallel PV module condition
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposes reduction of dc-link current ripple in unbalanced input voltage of three-parallel interleaved boost converter. The non-overlapped interval of diode currents of each boost converter can be occurred in case of the unbalanced input voltage. Therefore, the ripple of the dc-link current is increased. The non-overlapped interval is removed by adding the calculated phase to the carriers. Therefore, the current ripple is reduced by applying proposed method. The simulation results proved that dc-link current ripple is reduced about 36% by applying proposed switching method. The proposed method is verified through PSIM simulations.

articleTitle: Control and design of the bi-directional DC/DC converter for fuel-cell stack diagnostic in FCEV
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, control and design method of the fuel-cell (FC) stack diagnostic bi-directional converter are proposed. FC stack diagnostic converter is applied the bi-directional DC/DC converter for controlling the AC current. The AC current control is performed by applying the d-q transform for accurate current control. As a result, it can diagnose the status of the FC stack by supplying the AC current to the FC stack and monitoring the voltage and current of the FC stack. It is analyzed mathematically to design the bi-directional dc/de converter and considered the output ripple voltage and the inductor ripple current. The validity of proposed control method of the FC stack diagnostic bi-directional converter is verified by PSIM simulation results and proposed the 1.5kW FC stack diagnostic bi-directional converter.

articleTitle: The development of stand-alone battery pack for micro mobility EV
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Electric vehicles have become popular due to their zero emission and high efficiency. Especially, micro mobility EVs (one or two passenger vehicle) are rapidly increased. Micro mobility EV has gained attention as a means of transportation for short distances that allows for quick easy transportation and parking. Thermal management of battery pack in micro mobility EV is very important in terms of performance and battery life. Battery temperature influences the availability of discharging power and driving range, it also affects the life of the battery. Therefore, ideally, batteries should operate within an optimum temperature range through BTMS (Battery Thermal Management System).

articleTitle: A study on applicability of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) for electric propulsion ships
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The electric propulsion ship has been considered an alternative for stricter environmental regulations and safety issues. As electric propulsion ships have been developed, the attention given to a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) has also grown for green and efficient power supply. However, a BESS-installed ship is still regarded as a non-preferred power source in terms of reliability and cost-competitiveness. In this regard, this paper shows the possibility of a BESS-installed ship. Two major drawbacks of applying the BESS as a ship's power source are mentioned, and possible solutions are suggested and reviewed. These introduced solutions could contribute extending the applicability of a BESS and boosting its realistic utilization in the marine industry.

articleTitle: Cost benefit analysis of public service electric vehicles with vehicle-to-grid (V2G) capability
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this study, benefits of public service electric vehicles (EV) are investigated for three potential sectors, school bus, waste collecting truck, and city bus. The cost of operations is estimated based on their mobility patterns with environmental impacts and the gain from vehicle-to-grid is approximated by the optimized frequency regulation (FR) supports associated with the time-varying FR prices. Preliminary results show that the annual savings with EV services can be 8k to 22k USD per vehicle. The cost benefits are expected to increase further as the global warming emission constraints are getting tighter.

articleTitle: Design and control of power conversion system for ISG
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, design and control method of power conversion system for the 48[V] ISG system is proposed. Proposed ISG system is consist of bi-directional DC/DC converter, bi-directional DC/AC inverter, ISG motor, and 48 [V] and 12[V] batteries. There are three modes of integrated operation including initial start-up and 48[V] and 12[V] battery. Simulation and experimental results are given to verify the reliability of proposed ISG system.

articleTitle: Control of two-stage matrix converter under unbalanced source voltages
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, the topology of two-stage matrix converter (TSMC, also named indirect matrix converter) based on RB-IGBT has been presented. TSMC has the similar input/output performance as conventional matrix converter. Though there is a real DC link, no energy-stored capacitor is between the positive and negative of DC link. The unbalance of the source voltages can immediately reflect to the output of TSMC. The performance is degraded and the harmonics are generated in the input/output currents. A direct feed-forward optimization control scheme is developed to reduce the influence of input voltage unbalance to the load. The fundamental components of source voltages are first detected by ip-iq method. The results of simulation and experiments on a 10kW two-stage matrix converter prototype using RB-IGBT validate the performance of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Improvement of flux estimation using programmable low pass filter with synchronous angular frequency error compensator in sensorless AC induction motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A Phase Locked Loop (PLL) is highly valued and widely used for its simplicity; however, a low end PLL is inadequate to estimate a synchronous angular frequency due to a longer response/locking time. An auxiliary synchronous angular frequency error compensator is proposed to shorten the response time of the low end PLL and obtain an improved estimated synchronous angular frequency. It enhances the estimated synchronous angular frequency and the response time. Consequently, the estimated synchronous angular frequency is approaching the `true' angular frequency in a shorter period than one from the PLL alone.

articleTitle: An Optimum Harmonic Control of induction heating power supply system using multilevel neutral point clamped inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: An Optimum Harmonic Control of a new induction heating power supply with multilevel neutral point clamped inverter is introduced. The proposed system achieves the soft switching mode for both current and voltage with low harmonic distortion and the capability to maximize the heating power by controlling the harmonics.

articleTitle: Loss analysis & design of charge-pumped voltage supply for floating gate driver circuits in battery management system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The long turn-on time of floating power switches in BMS (battery management system) employ charge pump circuits generally. It is powered from the batteries so that power losses analysis is very important, but not easy. In this paper, a charge pump circuit will be introduced, which can be easily employed for BMSs as well as its operating principle will be explain in detail with calculation of the power consumption based on Charge Conservation Law. Finally, the analysis will be verified by a simulation.

articleTitle: Suspending control method of BLSRM based on adaptive fuzzy PID controller
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: BLSRM (Bearingless Switched Reluctance Motor) is a nonlinear, strong coupling and multi-variable system. The convertional control method is vulnerable to uncertain factors such as the load disturbance and satellite parameters' change. It is difficult to obtain a satisfactory control effect. Basing on a novel 8/10 BLSRM, whose suspending force control is separated with the torque control, this paper presents a novel suspending force control scheme. Conventional PID controllers in BLSRM radial force control must set initial parameters in advance according to engineers' knowledge, which will be unchanged during regulation. In order to solve this problem, adaptive fuzzy logic is applied to convertional PID controller for parameters self-tuning in this paper. Both fuzzy and parameters of PID controller are self-tuning on-line, which improve the performance of controller. Finally, simulation and experimental results show the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal routing and charging of an Uber-like electric vehicle considering dynamic electricity price and passenger satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper explores and presents a detailed mathematical model for optimal routing and charging of an Uber-like electric vehicle (EV) taking into account dynamic electricity price and passenger satisfaction. Based on an extended Pickup and Delivery Problem (PDP), the proposed optimization problem aims at the determination of the best route from the start node (origin) to the end node (final destination) while satisfying the requirements of all passengers (e.g., travel time and travel distance), together with reducing the driver's operation cost (e.g., electricity charging cost). The proposed model can be extended and developed into multi-vehicle optimal routing and charging problems.

articleTitle: A compensation method to reduce sampling delay of zero dead-time PWM using 3-level NPC PWM inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposed a compensation method for reducing sampling delay through ADC(Analog-to-Digital Converter) module of MCU(Micro Controller Unit) using ZDPWM method. In case of conventional PWM method of 3-level NPC inverter, the switching devices which is composed of silicon compounds are conducted complementary operation by both reference and carrier waveform. And this operating method needs to contain dead time state to prevent short-circuit fault. However, the phase voltage distortion is caused by the dead time state in conventional method. As a results, THD of phase current is increased when inverter system is operating. ZDPWM method which is non-complementary operation is suggested to compensate the distortion through dead time in 3-level NPC inverter. The ZDPWM method has some advantages such as simple operation through carrier waveform as same as conventional method and low harmonic factor at phase current based on non-complementary operation. However, the unexpected distortion of phase current can occur by phase angle delay through sampling of ADC module when the ZDPWM is used in experiment by MCU. Therefore, this paper proposed simple method to compensate sampling delay based on the modeling of delayed phase angle. The proposed method is demonstrated by experiment, and the method compares with same conditions as both conventional PWM method and the ZDPWM due to uncompensated sampling delay.

articleTitle: An integrated battery charger base on split-winding switched reluctance motor drive
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: With the development of plug in electric vehicle(PHEV), the onboard battery charger is received much attention. Compared with independent battery charger, the integrated battery charger can reduce the cost, the weight, the volume and so on. In this paper, an integrated battery charger base on split-winding switched reluctance motor (SRM) drive is proposed. In the integrated motor system, the boost and buck inductances are limited by the phase winding of the motor, so the performance of the integrated battery charger is cut down. In the proposed integrated motor drive, a novel converter topology and split-winding method are used to reduce the inductance and resistor of boost and buck inductances. Compare with conventional asymmetric converter, a relay and a diode are added in the proposed circuit. This topology can be rebuilt as a bridgeless buck-boost battery charger to satisfy the battery charging requirement. The operational modes of two functions are introduced in detail. Some simulation results are done to verify the performance of proposed converters.

articleTitle: Torque performance analysis of three-phase flux reversal machines for electric vehicle propulsion
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Flux reversal machines (FRMs) have a great potential in the field of electric vehicle (EV) propulsion due to their high torque density, robust structure, fast response, etc. This paper focuses on the analysis of the torque performances including average torque, cogging torque and ripple torque of three-phase FRMs. First, the general expressions of instantaneous torque and pulsating torque are analytically derived based on flux harmonic theory. Then, using the proposed equations, the effects of stator/rotor slot combination, split ratio, PM thickness, stator and rotor slot opening ratio on the torque performances are investigated and analyzed, which give a prediction for maximum achievable torque density and minimum possible pulsating torque of a FRM. Finally, the theoretical analyses are validated on a 12-stator-slot /17-rotor-slot FRM prototype.

articleTitle: Torque transfer efficiency estimation of the magnetic gear considering eddy current loss
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Magnetic gear which is capable of non-contact transfer torque has replaced mechanical gear and has advantages of high-efficiency and improved reliability. However, the magnetic gear has eddy current loss due to magnets unlike the mechanical gear. In addition, the magnetic gear has ferromagnetic pole pieces between two rotors. When kinds of steel use stainless (SUS) materials which have high strength is used to support these ferromagnetic pole pieces, the eddy current loss is generated through those materials. The eddy current loss becomes a main cause of decrease of torque transfer efficiency. Therefore, in a design process, investigating and analyzing the eddy current loss are very important. In this paper, the eddy current loss of the magnets and the pole pieces supporter is calculated using a non-linear finite element method (FEM) based on 3-D numerical analysis and the effect of eddy current loss on the torque transfer efficiency is analyzed. Furthermore, the reliability of this paper ensures by comparison the torque transfer efficiency of numerical analysis and the experiment.

articleTitle: An optimized simple current sharing function of SRM with intrgrated battery charger for EV drive
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Keeping position (KP), Zero torque (ZT) control and power factor correction (PFC) with DC battery charger integrated Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) drive is presented in this paper. For the proper DC charging with SRM winding as an inductance element of the PFC Circuit, a simple novel current sharing function (CSF) is proposed as a current reference distributor of the charging controller. The proposed CSF makes the proper reference for each phase windings of SRM to satisfy the total charging current of the battery with zero torque output to keep stand position with power factor correction while copper loss minimization during of battery charging is achieved. Based on these, CSFs can be used without any recalculation of optimal current at every sampling time. After CSF determination, there is no need to SRM model for online processing. A position sliding mode controller is used to overcome to any uncertainty such as mutual inductance or dc offset current sensor. Whereas, power factor correction and voltage adaption are obtained with three-phase buck type converter (or current source rectifier) that is cascaded with conventional SRM one for wide input and output voltage range. When electric vehicle (EV) is stopped, the three-phase buck type converter can be considered as a battery charger unit. Phase windings of SRM are used as large inductors for this stage. DC link inductor increases volume and cost of the input stage, so with using of SRM phase windings, this system is cost and volume effective without bulky DC link capacitor. In this integrated SRM drive battery charger, asymmetric SR converter used as an interleaved converter with boost mode operation. The validity of the proposed system is shown by simulation and verified experimentally by using a laboratory 4-KW SRM setup based on TI TMS320F28335 platform.

articleTitle: A study of TNPC type single-phase 5-level inverter for energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Multilevel inverter has better performance than existing 2-level inverters in terms of voltage stress, low THD and power efficiency. Voltage stress and high voltage application were serious problems of 2-level inverters in past. Implementing multilevel inverters to not only industrial energy conversion system, but also to home appliance system let consumers to use electronic devices safely and comfortably in long time. In this paper TNPC (T-type Neutral Pointed Clamped) 5-level inverter has been presented. The multilevel inverter has 5 kW power output. Proposed method performs system switching simply than TNPC switching module. Switching losses were significantly decreased, comparing to TNPC switching method. Advantages of the method were proved through PSIM and experiment results.

articleTitle: An integrated two-input three-output DC/DC boost converter with fuel-cell/battery energy resources for HEV and DC-distribution system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper studies an integrated two-input three-input dc/dc boost converter with fuel-cell (FC) and battery energy resources for hybrid electric vehicle (EV) connected to dc-distribution system. In the proposed power converter, the loads power can be flexibly distributed between input sources. Also, charging or discharging of battery storage device by Fe source can be controlled properly. The proposed converter has several outputs in series to achieve a high-voltage output which makes it suitable for interfacing to EV and dc-distribution system. Depending on charging and discharging states of the battery storage device, two different operating modes are defined. The proposed power converter has just one boost inductor and a diode-capacitors multiplier, the boost circuit output terminals and multiplier output terminal are stacked to increase the output voltage gain and to reduce the voltage stress on the power devices. The operational principle and steady-state analysis are described for each operation mode. The validity of the proposed power converter and its performance are verified by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: A experimental study on the development of VDR system for dynamic analysis of small electric propulsion vessels
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: VDR(Voyage Data Recorder), the system that saves ship motion and state information, is applied generally to large vessels, but to small vessels for a variety of reasons. However, as recent research and development about small electric propulsion ship is active, a system is required to ensure the durability of the electric propulsion system to measure the dynamic characteristics. Therefore, this study develops a small/low cost VDR system that can measure the dynamic characteristics about water motorcycle that has the biggest dynamic characteristics among small ships. And VDR system obtains more accurate position data by filtering the measurement data to the EKF (Extended Kalman Filter). Further, the dynamic characteristics analysis program, which receives the filtered data to calculate the load applied to an electric propulsion system, is developed and will be applied to HILS (Hardware In the Loop Simulation) through additional study.

articleTitle: A study on the magnetic resonant wireless charging system for electrical vehicles
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, a magnetic resonant wireless power transmission of charging system for electrical vehicles is proposed. Given that world's trend of wireless power transmission, it is adequate to select a resonant frequency 20kHz. A diameter of this system is 30cm, a height is 5cm and a distance between a transmitter and a receiver is 20cm. As a result, an output of this system is 1.7112W and an efficiency is 64.050%.

articleTitle: A study on high torque motor designed for Uni wheel Personal Mobility considering sloping domestic geographical features
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Because of increasing population and the environment problems, Personal Mobility is on the rise since 2012. Recently, Domestic market is filled by cheap products made by China. Therefore, This paper make estimation about one of those things released. And then, Making a design of Uni-wheel Personal Mobility considering sloping Domestic geographical feature using Vehicle Dynamic, Finite Elements Method (FEM) is used for the suitability on analysis of Electromagnetic field. Go through this study, Personal Mobility can make more high torque property and good for mountainous districts.

articleTitle: A novel 10kW hybrid converter for the electric vehicle charge applications
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A hybrid converter for the on-board charger consisting of a soft switching full bridge (SSFB) and a half bridge (HB) LLC resonant converter is proposed in this paper. The proposed topology adopts an additional switch and a diode at the secondary side of SSFB converter to guarantee the wide ZVS range of primary side switches and to eliminate the circulating current. The output voltage is regulated by controlling the duty cycle of secondary side switch. The effectiveness of the proposed converter was experimentally verified using a 10 kW prototype circuit. The experimental results show 96.8% peak efficiency.

Author Keywords: hybrid resonant and PWM power conversions

articleTitle: A new shipboard power supply system based on a rectifier transformer with integrated filtering reactor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In order to improve the power quality of shipboard power system (SPS), this paper proposes a new power supply system based on a rectifier transformer with integrated linear filtering reactors. Due to the reactors for filters are integrated into the rectifier transformer, the installed space for the filters can be reduced greatly. First, the topology of the proposed power supply is introduced and then, the principle of integrating the linear reactors into the transformer is presented. Furthermore, the operating mechanism for implementing the inductive filtering method is presented. Finally, the simulation and the experimental results validate the proposed power supply system and indicate that it can greatly reduce the harmonic currents at the source side, can improve the power factor effectively, and can reduce the noise of the rectifier transformer in SPS.

articleTitle: Control strategy of shunt active power filter module to utilize regenerative energy of lift load
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper deals with a control strategy of an active power filter module (APFM) which functions energy-saving by reusing regeneration energy of a traction motor for the lift load. The APFM can be used by additionally connecting dc-link of a usual inverter for motor of the lift load. In motoring mode, the deadbeat current control for APF function is used to mitigate delay factors depending upon data volume and interrupt processing of DSP associated with sampling time. The proposed method determines the operation mode and performs the control algorithm corresponding to each mode. The simulation is implemented to verify the proposed control method for APFM.

articleTitle: Noise suppression of fiber optic gyroscope based on variable tap-length adaptive filter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A variable tap-length algorithm for signal processing is introduced to solve the random drift problem of fiber optic gyroscope (FOG)'s output signal. In this paper, a variable tap-length least mean square algorithm (LMS) is utilized to find a optimal order in the noise suppression of FOG. Experiments are performed to show the efficiency of the proposed method, which can provide a good performance while remain an acceptable time consuming and calculation cost.

articleTitle: Design of adaptive matching circuit for sonar system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The functional architecture of sonar system is presented and its various functions are briefly described in order to describe the matching circuit in its context and to mark the matching circuit. The matching circuit can reduce the energy loss and system size of a sonar system by providing the variable reactive power to Sonar system, and also are influenced by the behavior of this load. In this paper, the basic topology of the matching circuit called an adaptive matching circuit is proposed, which is basically composed of variable inductor. First, the power circuit is designed in the power and frequency ranges of interest according to the given specification. Then, the control circuit is also designed through the modeling process. Finally the effectiveness of the proposed matching circuit is proved by using the computer simulation.

articleTitle: Dual active full-bridge bidirectional converter for V2G charger based on high-frequency AC buck-boost control strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In order to realize more optimized current stress of switches and soft switching in a wider range, this paper proposes a unified high-frequency AC buck/boost (UHFBB) control strategy for dual active-bridge bidirectional converter (DAB-BDC). The evolution of UHFBB theory is derived from buck and boost DC/DC converter operated in DCM. A multi-variable solving method is proposed to achieve the duty ratios for driven signals modulation. The calculation flow chart is given, which is the basis for the closed-loop control. The analysis is verified by the experimental results from a 500W prototype.

articleTitle: A novel fully-decoupled dual-mass silicon micromachined gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A novel fully-decoupled dual-mass silicon micro-machined Gyroscope is presented in this paper to reduce the coupling between the drive mode and sense mode for high performance. The theoretical analysis was made based on the simplified kinematics model. Then, the configuration of the dual-mass double-linear vibratory gyroscope, a three-frame structure, was given. The numerical simulation was made, which shows the decoupling effect of the design. Finally, tests were done on the fabricated prototype. The bias instability is 3.02°/h and the nonlinearity of scale factor is less than 50ppm, which prove that this gyroscope has exhibited good mode-decoupling effect and good performance.

articleTitle: Loss estimation of IPM motors to determine the performance of high performance application
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The paper focuses on predicting electromagnetic friction by modeling core losses of electric motors for high performance applications. The study shows procedural ways to simulate core loss beginning with theoretical explanation of the widely used core loss model, Bertotti model which was compared with more accurate loss surface model using finite element analysis. Individual contribution of core losses from each motor component was calculated to compare between the theoretical models. First, the finite element (FE) simulation procedure was introduced and followed by core loss model used for the simulation. The core loss for such motors will be calculated at no load and several operating torque/speed points. The simulation results were compared with test results to verify the applicability of the proposed model. Finally, Thermal analysis has been carried out to show the effect of core losses on temperature rise of motor.

articleTitle: C++ based dynamic model of AC induction motor in discrete time domain
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Three-phase AC Induction (ACI) motor's dynamic model in a stationary reference frame is coded in C++ programming language and verified. Three-phase ACI motor model is compared with commercial models such as Simulink model and found to work properly on any PC platforms. Most of the model simulation tests are passed successfully such as the torque/speed test and the stator flux versus the back emf. Its coding is concisely done based on the circuit equivalent to the generalized induction motor model. It is designed to replace a high-end and expensive commercial induction motor model for induction motor control algorithm developments and various educational teaching purposes at the college level.

articleTitle: A new method to analyse eddy current loss in an integrated magnetic structure for boost converter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposes a new integrated structure for the interleaved boost converter. The structure includes the main windings and the multipliers on the same core. Where the single core boost topology would provide a minimum iron losses. A new method to calculate the eddy current loss for the used core is presented. The method takes into consideration the effect of the harmonics at different duty cycles on the eddy current and hysteresis losses in the core. A prototype was build and test was carried out to verify the performance.

articleTitle: Model based sizing of electric heat pump air-conditioner in electric tractors
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Appropriate sizing of air-conditioner is critical for reducing energy consumption, especially for electric tractors in which considerable power is provided by the battery pack onboard under field work. This paper develops a heat model in order to describe the air temperature in a midsized electric tractor cabin under different environmental and working conditions. With reference to the recommended test standard of SAE J1503, the operator environmental temperature trajectories during air-conditioning as well as heater performance test procedures are simulated respectively. Based on the simulation results, sizing of the air-conditioner is determined.

articleTitle: Cogging torque reduction of brushless DC motor for an electric wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents a designing method to reduce the cogging torque of a brush less dc (BLDC) motor for an electric wheelchair. The initial model of a BLDC motor is designed by using the loading distribution method. Cogging torque is one of the main reasons not only to cause the torque ripple, but also to increase unwanted vibration of a BLDC motor. Response surface methodology (RSM) is conducted to optimize the initially designed model, and the length of the stator slot opening and notches are selected as design parameters in order to decrease the cogging torque of a BLDC motor. Also, 2D finite element method (FEM) is used to verify the validity of the proposed BLDC motor.

articleTitle: Control method for increasing efficiency of current-fed isolated bi-directional dual half-bridge converter using resonant switch
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposes a new control method for a current-fed isolated bi-directional dual half-bridge DC/DC converter using a resonant switch (CF-IDHCR) to improve efficiency. CF-IDHCR is based on a current-fed half bridge converter, and the diodes bridge are replaced with MOSFETs to provide bi-directional operation. The resonant components in CF-IDHCR are used to increase the efficiency by achieving soft switching for all active switches, thus the switching loss can be reduced. However, it is difficult to increase system efficiency because of large peak current and inherent reactive power. A proposed control method, which is named by dual phase-shift control, can decrease reactive power and switch peak current, thereby system efficiency can be improved. This paper presents theoretical analysis of the proposed control method, and it is verified by a PSIM 9.1.4 simulation results.

articleTitle: Half bridge LLC resonant converter with high voltage gain for single-phase AC/DC power system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper proposes a half bridge LLC resonant converter with high voltage gain employing Silicon Carbide (SiC) metal-oxide-semi-conductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET) for the DC/DC stage in the single-phase AC/DC power system. This converter is based on the switch integration techniques, which is merging the active-clamp forward (ACF) circuit and HB LLC resonant converter. The primary conduction loss can be significantly reduced by the high voltage gain. Although high voltage rating MOSFET is required, by applying high voltage rating SiC MOSFET with low channel resistance, the proposed converter can show high performance. Moreover, to asymmetric pulse width modulation (APWM), the optimal design for high efficiency can be achieved regardless the hold-up time and large ripple voltage. The validity of the proposed converter is confirmed by the experimental results of a prototype converter with 400VDC input and 800W (12V/65A) output.

articleTitle: Power semiconductors for mobile heavy duty applications
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Large mobile applications like buses used in public transportation have different demands towards power electronics than fixed industrial installations. Vibration is a major topic, accompanied by restrictive space targets. Industrial power semiconductors support the desired form factor and the power density targeted but improvement in mechanical and thermal properties is needed to achieve the lifetime required to support commercial vehicles. In public transportation, both worlds come together when electric buses and the necessary infrastructure for charging is considered as a combined system.

articleTitle: The force identification of 200kW IPMSM using phase reference spectrum
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents one of the methods for estimation of the electromagnetic excitation force of the motor. In order to identify the excitation force of the motor, vibration data was obtained using phase reference spectrum to overcome a number of channels of the DAQ instrument. FE model of the 200kW motor was made to calculate the transfer function from FEM analysis. Impact test was carried out and compared impact test results with FEM analysis results to verify the FE model of 200kW motor. The singular value decomposition was used to reduce calculation errors of the force identification, and pseudo inverse used to solve the matrix inverse problem. This equivalent excitation force is useful to design 200kW motor.

articleTitle: Design of wound field synchronous machine as an in-axis motor for electric vehicle traction system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper presents the design and performance analysis of a wound-field synchronous machine as an in-axis motor for electric vehicle traction system. The design target is that maximum output power is 60kW and the power density is more than 0.95 kW/kg. To improve power density without permanent magnet, the gear was used. Furthermore, to keep the inside of the vehicle structure, two motor was used for one traction system. Therefore 30kW-grade motor was designed. In the initial design process, equivalent magnetic circuit method was used. For the detail design to reduce torque ripple, response surface methodology was used.

articleTitle: Optimal control method for electric propulsion systems of green ships based on HILS test
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, we propose the optimal servo design method for the speed control of green ships with 200kW electric propulsion systems. The proposed linear quadratic servo controller with integrator reflects not only the steady state error, but the performance index with respect to ship dynamic states and input energy. While the existing linear PI control method doesn't consider the input energy unless the input fuel limitation, the speed tracking and energy minimization are obtained by the proposed method. The performance index with linear quadratic form with states and inputs is determined by solving the inverse problem of algebraic Riccati equation. The effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by the real time simulation test using the hardware-in the loop simulation for electrical propulsion systems of the green ships.

articleTitle: PFC and zero torque control of SRM drive for EV battery charging
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Integrated switched reluctance motor drive as an electric vehicle battery charger is presented in this paper. The SRM, which is used as the traction power in the driving mode, is used in the charge circuit to improve the power factor of charging system. The charging circuit can share the power switches of the asymmetric converter and phase windings of SRM to charge the battery, and can reduce the size and cost of the system in the plug-in system. To keep the rotor at standstill, zero torque control method is proposed. Since the inductances of the SRM windings are not same at any stop position, the charger controller controls the reference current to satisfy the total charging current with PFC and zero torque condition. A novel cubic equation method is proposed as a current reference distributor of the charging controller. Simulations are performed by MATLAB software and results satisfy the Effectiveness of proposed battery charging system.

articleTitle: Implementation of a system plug-in a conventional hybrid vehicle and improve EV condition with an extra set of batteries and electronic control
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This article describes the study and development of a plug-in system in a conventional hybrid vehicle with the purpose to minimize fuel consumption and extend driving in EV mode, this with the help of groups of gel batteries and implementing additional electronics to allow the coupling of two sets of batteries. The main objective is to demonstrate the capacity increase in EV mode operation in a hybrid vehicle; the system the system incorporates an electronic control stage for management, and can be plugged into a power supply line of 110 Volts compatible with existing in the home, office.

articleTitle: Multilevel single-phase inverter based on TNPC-type
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A new single-phase 7-level pulse-width modulation (PWM) inverter using T-type Neutral-point-clamped (TNPC) celIs is presented to obtain high quality output voltage minimizing the number of switching devices. It includes two TNPC cells series-connected together and connected to with different voltage levels. To avoid inherent problems caused by voltage unbalance, modified Buck-boost converters are added at DC-link side to make DC voltage sources for the proposed inverter. Operational principles and the switching pattern are analyzed in this paper. To verify the performance of the proposed inverter, PSIM simulation and experimental results are also shown in this paper.

articleTitle: A new compensation method to improve the dynamic characteristics of DC-link voltage in multi-function rapid charger for electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A multi-function rapid charger (MFRC) performs the operation either active power filter (APF) mode or battery charging mode. The MFRC operates on APF mode for improving the power quality of the grid. When electric vehicle (EV) comes to charging station, the MFRC is operated on battery charging mode and it causes DC-link voltage to fluctuate because the electric energy is transferred abruptly from DC-link to the batteries on EVs. In this paper, a new compensation control method is proposed to improve the dynamic characteristics of MFRC. Simulations have been carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Construction of frequency regulation RESS based on advanced cell grouping combined with the DWT
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This approach newly gives insight to the design and implementation of an advanced lithium nickel cobalt aluminum oxide (LiNoCoAlO2 or NCA) cell grouping combined with the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) for frequency regulation renewable energy storage system (RESS) in grid-connected application. For an advanced NCA cell grouping, the discharge capacity and two open-circuit voltages (OCVs) before and after capacity measurement, and hybrid pulse power characterization (HPPC)-based resistances at a specific state-of-charge (SOC) point are firstly measured. The most important thing in this approach is to consider the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) as the major role, especially high-frequency component decomposed by the DWT-based multi-resolution analysis (MRA), for frequency regulation RESS. According to this proposed approach, it can be absolutely expected to reduce cell-to-cell voltage and SOC imbalances in the tray and to have an efficient RESS in grid-connected application.

articleTitle: Direct power control with common mode voltage elimination for open-winding brushless doubly-fed wind power generators
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, a new open-winding control strategy is proposed for a brushless doubly-fed reluctance generator (BDFRG) applicable for wind turbines. The BDFRG control winding is fed via a dual two-level three-phase converter using a single dc bus. Direct power control based on maximum power point tracking with common mode voltage elimination is designed, which not only the active and reactive power is decoupled, but the reliability and redundancy are all improved greatly by increasing the switching modes of operation, while DC-link voltage and rating of power devices decreased by 50% comparing to the traditional three-level converter systems. Consequently its effectiveness is evaluated by simulation tests based on a 42-kW prototype generator.

articleTitle: Heading control study for electrical driven system of floating LNG unit
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: The minimum rated thruster capacity is determined for assisting LNG Vessel (LNGC) berthing operation during holding mode, where thrusters are expected to provide lee-side area for the LNGC and tug boats by rotating the Floating LNG (FLNG) against wave with certain wave heading angle during berthing operation. The expected capacity of thruster for offloading operations is an important design basis for FLNG unit. The paper presents the findings from the study in the interests of sharing information with industry.

articleTitle: Furtive charging system for electric yard tractor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: In this paper, a yard tractor (YT) with furtive charging system is investigated. A furtive charging system charges battery of YT without intervening operation schedules of YTs. To achieve furtive charging, wireless charging is adopted. Charging of YT is accomplished when YT is waiting under RTGC (Rubber Type Gantry Crane) and/or RMQC (Rail Mounted Quay Crane).

articleTitle: A simplified FOG output error model based on thermal diffusion
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: Fiber optic gyroscope (FOG) is a kind of high precision angular rate sensor which is highly affected by environment temperature. Research on FOG temperature error is meaningful for improving its environmental performance. In this paper, a simplified FOG output error model is presented by using reduced discretized parameters. Simulation results show the residual error and computational complexity of the proposed method with different discretized parameters.

articleTitle: Hybrid DC/DC converter for EV OBC with single transformer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: This paper suggests hybrid PWM DC/DC converter comprised of FB converter and PWM resonant converter for EV OBC. It has hybrid operational characteristics that switching characteristic follow PWM resonant converter and output characteristic are similar to those of FB converter. They are coupled in single transformer so that power distribution problem that causes size increase of transformer can be solved. Also, the proposed structure helps to simplify the circuit by removing dissipative snubber circuitry and output current filter because transformer leakage inductance is used for resonant parameter and the output inductor current ripple is very small. Top switches can be operated with zero-voltage-switching (ZVS) and bottom switching devices can have ZVS and zero-current-switching (ZCS) by proper design of the resonant tank. The feasibility of the proposed charger is verified with a 6.6kW prototype implemented by design procedure.

articleTitle: Effects of Fe and Mn co-doping on electrochemical properties of Li3V2−2xFexMnx(PO4)3/graphene cathode for lithium secondary battery
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE Transportation Electrification Conference and Expo, Asia-Pacific (ITEC Asia-Pacific)
abstract: A series of Fe and Mn co-doped Li<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-2</sub>xFexMnx(PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/graphene (x = 0, 0.005, 0.010, 0.015, 0.020, and 0.025) samples have been fabricated via a sol-gel assisted microwave synthesis method. The crystal structure and morphology of the synthesized Li3V2-2xFexMnx(PO4)3/graphene was investigated using XRD and SEM systematically. Electrochemical measurement results prove that the Li<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.98</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.01</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.01</sub>(PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/graphene sample presents the best electrochemical performance among the as-prepared samples.
